evidence: Hash check: sha256 of frozen instruction.md (256c5b5d...), hireops_rules.md (38fff76c...), integration.md (1b56dd3f...), seed_data.json (a1c65c80...), test.sh (bd682592...), app_context.md (ceda398c...), functional judge.toml (22625876...), polish judge.toml (65a11629...), functional prompt.md (e337e950...) equal manifest.json inputs. RUNTIME FACT LIST vs what the verifier consumes (tests/test.sh:48,68,97-111): (1) path/entry: instruction.md:13 'Put the application in /app ... It must start with node /app/server.js'; integration.md:5 'The process starts from /app/server.js'; test.sh:68 refuses when /app/server.js is missing, :111 node "$APP_ENTRY". (2) port: instruction.md:13 'listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set)'; integration.md:5-6 'listens on port 3000 on 0.0.0.0'; test.sh:108 PORT=3000 and probes 127.0.0.1:3000; app_context.md:4 URL http://localhost:3000. (3) storage/DB_PATH: instruction.md:13 'keep its durable data in /app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH when that is set'; integration.md:7-8; test.sh:98-101,109 DB_PATH=$APP_DB (/app/app.db or the writable copy); hireops_rules.md:196-202 tells the agent the runtime may launch a writable copy from another cwd, unprivileged, with only PATH/HOME/NODE_PATH/PORT/DB_PATH - exactly test.sh:104-110 (env -i, setpriv 65534, HOME=$APP_COPY). (4) health: instruction.md:13 'expose GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database'; integration.md:9-10; test.sh:48 probes /api/health then /. (5) seed: instruction.md:13,15 'using the seed data at /assets/seed_data.json' and '/assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime. Load ... once, start with no shipped database, and keep new work across restarts'; hireops_rules.md:204-209 explains read-marker semantics and page size 30; solve.sh deletes any shipped db. (6) accounts: instruction.md:17 lists all 10 emails with roles and password Hireops!2026; matches seed users and tests/app_context.md:8-19. (7) packages/symlinks: instruction.md:13 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages'; integration.md:3-4 Express + better-sqlite3 via NODE_PATH (both environment/Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile install express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 globally with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules); integration.md:16-19 symlink rule matches test.sh:72-83. (8) fixed clock: N-A for this task - no criterion depends on the current date or relative time; seed timestamps are fixed past values (messages from 2026-07-01, notes 2026-07-20..25) and each conversation's created_at is strictly increasing (re-derived), so 'most recent 30, oldest first' is unambiguous; the only timing is the 15-second live window stated at instruction.md:5 and hireops_rules.md:117. Network is public (task.toml network_mode = 'public'), so no offline constraint is needed. GRADED-vs-ASKED sweep over all 2 gate, 39 functional, 5 polish and 5 visual criteria: job-open validation (blank title, places 0/51/2.5, non-HM manager) <- rules:27-29 'a whole number from 1 to 50', 'chosen from the hiring-manager accounts'; add-candidate at bottom of Applied, email validity, case-insensitive duplicate, error at field with typed values kept, other job allowed <- rules:31-36; one-stage moves, skips refused, non-drag controls, immediate display on mover's board <- rules:47-52,84; arrival at bottom, re-order with ordinary controls, shared order <- rules:57-59; reject needs reason, not from Hired, rejected-from remembered, reopen only there with reason cleared, undo restores reason <- rules:49-51,96-97; interview cap, re-order in full Interview allowed, freed place reusable, undo over cap refused <- rules:63-65,98; refused move put back with reason and focus on the card <- rules:84-85; HM late stages on own jobs, reject from Interview/Offer and reopen those, HM cannot open job or add candidate <- rules:28,31,69-73; observer/candidate change nothing, 401/403/404 statuses <- rules:21-23,73; stale move 409 naming who <- rules:77-80 and instruction.md:3; bulk all-or-none, board order, mixed stages, cap counted for the set <- rules:89-92; undo own last move only, blocked by move/re-order/reject by anyone, note does not count, once only, earlier move lost after later one <- rules:96-100; Activity readable who/what/reason, newest first, all-or-one-job filter, refused adds none, observer reads <- rules:16,110-113; note permissions <- rules:104-106; live board/messages/unread/seen within 15 s without reload while preserving typing, focus, open card and scroll <- instruction.md:5, rules:117-123; plain-text messages (literal <b>), blank refused, Enter/Shift+Enter, cleared and focused after send, failed send kept with notice <- rules:138-140; latest 30 oldest-first scrolled to newest, earlier 30 at a time with remaining count, anchor preserved <- rules:144-147; per-person unread with total, open-at-newest counts read, scrolled-up notice <- rules:151-160; seen rules incl. HM and excluding observer <- rules:164-166; reply drafts per person/conversation/browser surviving navigation, reload and ended session with sign-in prompt, hidden from other users, plus note drafts per person/browser <- rules:106,170-175; candidate list with title/team/candidate wording and own conversations only, no notes/reason/rejected-from/positions/others/activity, foreign application = 404 <- rules:179-194, instruction.md:9; restart persistence without reseeding <- instruction.md:15, integration.md:8-9. Seed figures the criteria use (Platform Engineer Applied Greta Lindqvist/Ade Bello/Marco Rossi, Screen Priya Nair/Samuel Ortiz; Noor's note text; Lena 1 unread = read_count 2 of 3 with last message by a recruiter; Noor's 120-message conversation) were re-derived from the shipped seed and match. Visual likert rows grade desktop craft, consistent with instruction.md:11 'A clear desktop workspace is what matters'. No graded demand names a route, selector, label, storage mechanism or wording the brief does not give; functional prompt.md:15 says 'Do not require routes, selectors, field names, layouts or exact wording'. Adversarial tries: (a) plausible broken app - one with no card version that only checks that the target stage is one step from the current stage would accept protocol C's exact replay (F is back in Applied) and correctly FAILS hro_stale_refused; the version requirement is public at rules:77-78, so the loss is fair, not hidden. (b) conforming alternatives - an app that shows the rejected-from stage only in its reopen control or Activity line still passes hro_reject_reason (four surfaces accepted); a candidate replay naming another application answered 404 is accepted by hro_refusal_status as rules:22-23 allow; candidate staff replays not naming an application must be 403, which rules:21-22 state. I found no graded behavior lacking a public requirement and no verifier runtime fact missing from instruction.md or the /instructions notes. Minor observation (not a defect): that staff can see the rejected-from stage is implied (rules:50 'remembers', :51 reopen only to it, :110 Activity says 'what changed') rather than stated as a display requirement; the criterion's four accepted surfaces keep this fair. Scope: source review of public text against criteria, prompts and test.sh; not a configured judge run, Oracle grade or model score, none of which this row needs. The mechanical string agreement belongs to check-runtime-contract-strings.py (deterministic reviewer).
